cross_source_verdicts: No single source covers inventory+geometry+norm+version: minimum chain = national inventory (MITECO/OAPN) + CCAA gazette (norm) + consolidation status (per-gazette, heterogeneous)
BOE consolidada covers state framework + park declaration laws but NOT PRUG decrees — verified empirically

Gazette heterogeneity is real: DOGC (Socrata+Akoma Ntoso+ELI) and BOCyL (Opendatasoft+per-doc XML) are API-grade; BOA/BOC-Cantabria/BOPA are document-grade; BOJA has a consolidated portal without verified API
